annotation_method: manual sole/boot centres on the 64px raster, reviewed using feet_grid.png; approximate foot identity and contact intervals, not a 3D IK solve
far_leg: darker leg without the large bright pocket
cycle_measurement: 2 * mean(near centre x0-x4 =15.5, far centre x4-x0 =13.5); both sheets retain the same approximate leg path; torso scale same 36px
limitations: Sole centre is not the same physical ground-contact point through heel-to-toe roll. Frame-hold drift and full candidate-support spread are reported separately. Backward traversal reverses phases; dedicated backward/vertical art remains absent.
